ModuleTitle.label: Module Title
ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.label: Module Anchor
ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Creates a direct #anchor link to this section. Use letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

SectionTitle.label: Section Title
SectionTitle.helper: Optional heading displayed above the activity cards. Formatted text and links are allowed and will be rendered as entered.

SectionEyebrow.label: Section Eyebrow
SectionEyebrow.helper: Optional short label displayed above the section title. Formatted text and links are allowed and will be rendered as entered.

SectionEyebrowColor.label: Section Eyebrow Color
SectionEyebrowColor.helper: Choose a Bootstrap or theme text color with enough contrast against the section background.

SectionDescription.label: Section Description
SectionDescription.helper: Optional supporting text below the title. Formatted text and links are allowed and will be rendered as entered.
SectionDescription.placeholder: A quick view of the work that needs attention.

SectionFooter.label: Section Footer
SectionFooter.helper: Optional note displayed below the activity cards. Formatted text and links are allowed and will be rendered as entered.
SectionFooter.placeholder: Select a card to review the related feature.

Alerts.label: Alert Banners
Alerts.helper: Optional. Add one or more alerts. One saved alert is selected at random for each page render.

Content.label: Content
Content.helper: Required when this alert is used. Formatted text and links are allowed and will be rendered as entered.
Content.placeholder: A short message about an important website task or update.

Icon.label: Icon
Icon.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

ActionLabel.label: Action Label
ActionLabel.helper: Optional. Short label for the alert action button.

ActionUrl.label: Action URL
ActionUrl.helper: Optional. Local and external web addresses are supported. External links open in a new tab.
